party_a_statement: Photographer B delivered wedding album 6 months late. Several ceremony moments were missing.
party_b_statement: Delivery was delayed because couple did not select shortlist photos for 4 months. All 800 raw photos were delivered on time.

evidence.description: Email thread showing photographer requesting photo shortlist
evidence.text: Email on 10 Oct 2025: 'Please select 100 photos for album binding'. Reminder sent 15 Nov, 20 Dec. Couple sent shortlist only on 1 Feb 2026.

evidence.description: Google Drive delivery timestamp of all raw photos
evidence.text: Cloud delivery confirmation: 840 RAW files accessed by client on 5 Oct 2025 (48 hours after wedding).
